name: The ePlane Company
one_liner: Electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft and unmanned aerial vehicles for short-range intracity travel. Incubated at IIT Madras, grown out of a combustion research lab; founded 2016.

name: Unbox Robotics
one_liner: Compact, AI-assisted robotic package-sorting systems for the warehouses and fulfilment centres of e-commerce and logistics companies. Pune-based, founded 2019.

name: Wint Wealth
one_liner: A platform that makes bond-market products accessible to retail investors in India. Early on it was run almost manually.

name: Giva
one_liner: An online-first fine silver jewellery brand founded in 2019, later expanding into gold and lab-grown diamonds and building offline presence.

name: SuperK
one_liner: A tech-enabled grocery retail network for small towns. It rebrands existing neighbourhood stores under its own name and provides standardised pricing, supply, discounts and digital billing.

name: Jai Kisan
one_liner: A fintech platform providing financing to farmers and rural households for income-generating purchases such as agricultural and dairy equipment. Mumbai-based, founded 2017.

name: MeetRecord
one_liner: Meeting notes and call summaries (a meeting-notes and call-summary product).
source_note: Partner Meeting Notes, meeting 4. The description is inferred from the overlap discussed there; the fund's own wording was not provided.
